vedic_reference.note: The name Janesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'jananumati' meaning 'God obedient to the mother' and 'Ishvara' meaning 'God'. It is not directly mentioned in any Vedic text, but the concept of a God who follows the will of his mother is present in Hindu mythology, particularly in the story of Lord Krishna and his mother Devaki.
